info.title: Pav Enterprise API
info.description:
Read-only `/v1` API over Pav's biopharma dataset: drug programs, companies, clinical trials, deals, patent families, a change feed, and dataset stats.

Authenticate every request with a Clerk API key as a bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Mint a key in [Pav developer settings](https://app.pav.bio/settings/developer).

All endpoints are `GET` and return JSON. List endpoints return a `{ data, pagination }` envelope. Pass `q=` to run hybrid semantic + keyword search ranked by relevance; omit it for a filtered, paginated listing. Errors return `{ error: { code, message, request_id } }`.

get.description: Type-ahead suggestions for a program search box. Given a partial `q=` and optional active filters, runs the same hybrid semantic + keyword search as `GET /v1/programs` and returns the top matching programs (company, drug, indication) — not facet values. Select one and filter by its `company_id`, or submit `q=` to `GET /v1/programs` for the full page.

get.description:
Search and filter the Pav pipeline of drug programs.

Provide `q=` to run hybrid semantic + keyword search ranked by relevance (search responses report `pagination.total = null`). Omit `q=` for a filtered, sortable, paginated listing with optional exact totals via `include_total=true`. Filters and `q=` combine with AND semantics.

Filter coverage note: `target` and `modality` have partial coverage in the source data. Filtering on a sparsely populated field restricts results to programs where that field is populated, which can shrink the result set.

get.description:
List clinical trials linked to one company, in the same role-aware shape as `/v1/trials/{nct_id}` (`lead_sponsor`, `collaborators`, `sponsors`, `company_ids`, `programs`).

A trial is linked to a company through either path:
- **program bridge** — a Pav program the company owns is mapped to the trial (`via=program`);
- **sponsor resolution** — the trial's resolved sponsor org links to the company (`via=sponsor`).

`via=any` (default) returns the union. Pass `include_total=true` for an exact match count. Returns `404 not_found` if the company id is unknown.

get.description:
Biopharma deals — M&A, licensing, collaborations, options, joint ventures and distribution — extracted from SEC filings and press releases, one row per deal with its current lifecycle state and headline economics.

Every filter is optional and filters combine with AND. `q` is an exact-term full-text match (English stemming; every term must match) over the deal name, event headline, summary and rights, or a substring of a party's name. It does not expand synonyms, so search each phrasing you care about. With no filters you get the most recent deal activity.

get.description:
US patent families from the current USPTO snapshot, one row per family (a root application with its continuations, divisionals and provisionals). Every filter is optional and filters combine with AND.

`company_id` matches families whose live members are owned by that company, through the USPTO assignee crosswalk. About a quarter of families map to a company, so no rows for a company does not mean it holds no patents. A lapsed family has no live owners, so `company_id` with `state=lapsed` returns nothing.

get.description: The change log of detected pipeline movements, newest first, with a gap-free KEYSET cursor. `entity=program` (default) returns program phase/add/remove events on our clock (`detected_at`). `entity=trial` now returns `410 Gone`; the old Postgres CT.gov mirror feed is retired until a GCS/TurboPuffer-backed trial change feed is available. Paginate with the returned `next_cursor` via `?cursor=` (stable under concurrent inserts); `since=` bounds the start. `offset` is accepted for back-compat but `cursor` is preferred and wins when both are sent. `entity=all` is not supported — poll the program and trial feeds separately. By default only current (non-invalidated) program changes are returned; pass `include_invalidated=true` to also see retracted ones (program only).

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: When Pav first read the document (UTC).

raw_text.title: Raw Text
raw_text.description: The term as the source states it.
examples: total enterprise value of approximately US$11.3 billion

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Monetary amount in base currency units. Null for percentages or unstated values.

not_disclosed.title: Not Disclosed
not_disclosed.description: True when the source explicitly withholds this term.

ontology.title: Ontology
ontology.description: Source ontology for the resolved indication term (e.g. MONDO).

source_text.title: Source Text
source_text.description: Original indication text the term was resolved from.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Resolver confidence in the term match, 0-1.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of rows returned for this request.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Zero-based row offset applied before returning results.

total.title: Total
total.description: Total matching rows across all pages. Null on relevance-ranked search responses and on listings requested without `include_total`.

representative_title.title: Representative Title
representative_title.description: Title of the family's representative member.
examples: GLUCAGON LIKE PEPTIDE 1 (GLP-1) FUSION PEPTIDE ... CONJUGATES AND USES THEREOF

latest_status_date.title: Latest Status Date
latest_status_date.description: Most recent status change on any member. Default sort key.

has_live_member.title: Has Live Member
has_live_member.description: True when any member is pending or in force.

owner_names.title: Owner Names
owner_names.description: Recorded owners of the live members. Empty for a lapsed family.

owner_is_split.title: Owner Is Split
owner_is_split.description: True when live members have different owners.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Owners resolved to Pav companies. About a quarter of families map to a company, so an empty list does not mean the company holds no patents.

members.title: Members
members.description: Member applications, newest filed first. Present with `include_members=true`.

has_live_member.title: Has Live Member
has_live_member.description: True when any member is pending or in force.

owner_names.title: Owner Names
owner_names.description: Owners of the live members; for a lapsed family, owners across all members.

owner_is_split.title: Owner Is Split
owner_is_split.description: True when live members have different owners.

has_open_security_interest.title: Has Open Security Interest
has_open_security_interest.description: True when any member carries an open security interest.

latest_maintenance_fee_date.title: Latest Maintenance Fee Date
latest_maintenance_fee_date.description: Most recent maintenance-fee payment on any member.

statutory_term_start.title: Statutory Term Start
statutory_term_start.description: Earliest nonprovisional filing the family claims (35 USC 154(a)(2)). Null when an ancestor's filing date is unknown.

statutory_term_end.title: Statutory Term End
statutory_term_end.description: `statutory_term_start` plus 20 years. Term adjustments and extensions are not applied.

events.title: Events
events.description: Prosecution and maintenance events, newest first (capped).

patent_number.title: Patent Number
patent_number.description: Granted patent number; null until granted.

role.title: Role
role.description: Member's place in the family (root, continuation, ...).

is_dead.title: Is Dead
is_dead.description: True when the application is abandoned or expired.

has_open_security_interest.title: Has Open Security Interest
has_open_security_interest.description: True when an open security interest (lien) is recorded on this member.

patent_number.title: Patent Number
patent_number.description: Granted patent number; null until granted.

role.title: Role
role.description: Member's place in the family (root, continuation, ...).

is_dead.title: Is Dead
is_dead.description: True when the application is abandoned or expired.

application_numbers.title: Application Numbers
application_numbers.description: Members the conveyance was recorded on.

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: The trial's primary endpoint measure (what is being assessed).

time_frame.title: Time Frame
time_frame.description: Time frame over which the primary outcome is measured.

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text description/definition of the primary outcome.
examples: Patients are considered a failure if they die, progress, or relapse.

id.title: Id
id.description: Durable Pav program identifier. Stable across refreshes and preserved when a program is discontinued, so a held id keeps resolving.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state of the program: `active` while the company still publishes it, or `discontinued` once it drops off the pipeline. List and search endpoints return only `active` programs; a single-program lookup by id still returns a `discontinued` one.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Pav company identifier that owns this program.

short_name.title: Short Name
short_name.description: Internal company slug used as a stable join key.

company.title: Company
company.description: Display name of the company that owns this program.

drug.title: Drug
drug.description: Drug or asset name for the program.

indication.title: Indication
indication.description: Indication the program targets, as published by the company.

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: Development phase as published by the company (raw label).

phase_norm.title: Phase Norm
phase_norm.description: Phase normalized to Pav's canonical phase vocabulary.

modality.title: Modality
modality.description: Drug modality as published by the company (raw label).

modality_norm.title: Modality Norm
modality_norm.description: Modality normalized to Pav's canonical modality vocabulary. May be null where the modality could not be inferred.

target.title: Target
target.description: Molecular target of the asset. Coverage is partial — many programs have no published target and this field is null for them.

mechanism_of_action.title: Mechanism Of Action
mechanism_of_action.description: Mechanism of action for the asset.

territory.title: Territory
territory.description: Territory/region the program applies to, when disclosed.

description.title: Description
examples: Oral GLP-1 receptor agonist for type 2 diabetes and obesity.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Additional program notes captured from the source.

partners.title: Partners
partners.description: Collaboration/partnership entries associated with the program.

clinical_trials.title: Clinical Trials
clinical_trials.description: Clinical trials linked to this program.

indication_terms.title: Indication Terms
indication_terms.description: Ontology terms resolved from the program's indication text.

target_terms.title: Target Terms
target_terms.description: Ontology terms (NCIT/HGNC) resolved from the program's target text.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: URL of the company source page the program was scraped from.

source_run_id.title: Source Run Id
source_run_id.description: Pav scrape run identifier that produced this program snapshot.

source_scraped_at.title: Source Scraped At
source_scraped_at.description: Timestamp the source page was scraped (UTC).

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Stable company id — send back as a `company_id` filter.

ProgramSuggestion.title: ProgramSuggestion
ProgramSuggestion.description:
One hybrid-search-box suggestion: a concrete program, not a facet value.

``/v1/programs/autocomplete`` runs the same hybrid search as ``/v1/programs``
and returns the top matching programs for a search-as-you-type box.

program_id.title: Program Id
program_id.description: The program the similar set was computed for.

data.title: Data
data.description: Programs most similar to the source program, ranked by similarity.

name.title: Name
name.description: Sponsor organization name as recorded on ClinicalTrials.gov (`clinical_trial_org.name`). This is the registry org name, NOT the trial-index sponsor display string.

role.title: Role
role.description: Sponsor role on the trial: `lead_sponsor`, `collaborator`, or `owner`.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Pav company identifier the org resolved to, when the sponsor was linked to a tracked company. Null for unresolved orgs.

short_name.title: Short Name
short_name.description: Internal company slug the org resolved to, when linked.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Resolver confidence in the org->company link (e.g. `medium`).

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: Total number of pipeline programs tracked.

distinct_phases.title: Distinct Phases
distinct_phases.description: Count of distinct normalized phases present.

distinct_modalities.title: Distinct Modalities
distinct_modalities.description: Count of distinct normalized modalities present.

by_phase.title: By Phase
by_phase.description: Program counts grouped by normalized phase.

by_modality.title: By Modality
by_modality.description: Program counts grouped by normalized modality.

ontology.title: Ontology
ontology.description: Source ontology for the resolved target term (NCIT or HGNC).

source_text.title: Source Text
source_text.description: Original target text the term was resolved from.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Resolver confidence in the term match, 0-1.

nct_url.title: Nct Url
nct_url.description: Canonical ClinicalTrials.gov URL for the trial record.

title.title: Title
title.description: Official or brief title of the trial.
examples: A Study of a Vaccine to Prevent COVID-19

phase.title: Phase
phase.description: Trial phase as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov.

status.title: Status
status.description: Overall recruitment/operational status of the trial.

program_count.title: Program Count
program_count.description: Number of Pav programs linked to this trial.

company_short_names.title: Company Short Names
company_short_names.description: Pav company slugs linked to this trial via the program bridge (scraped pipeline -> clinical trial). This is membership from the program linkage only; for the full sponsor-role graph see `company_ids` and `sponsors`.

lead_sponsor.description: Lead sponsor resolved from the ClinicalTrials.gov role graph. Null for trials with no normalized sponsor org (e.g. pre-2016 records).

collaborators.title: Collaborators
collaborators.description: Collaborator sponsors resolved from the role graph.

sponsors.title: Sponsors
sponsors.description: All sponsors (lead, collaborators, owners) resolved from the role graph, ordered by role rank then registry org id.

company_ids.title: Company Ids
company_ids.description: Deduped, sorted union of Pav company ids linked to this trial via resolved sponsors and via the program bridge — the cross-entity join key for trial<->company<->program.

programs.title: Programs
programs.description: Pav programs linked to this trial via the program bridge.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Trial start date as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov.

last_update_post_date.title: Last Update Post Date
last_update_post_date.description: Date the trial record was last updated on ClinicalTrials.gov.

primary_completion_date.title: Primary Completion Date
primary_completion_date.description: Primary completion date as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov — the date the last participant was examined or received an intervention for primary-outcome data collection. A key resolution date.

completion_date.title: Completion Date
completion_date.description: Study completion date as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov.

results_first_post_date.title: Results First Post Date
results_first_post_date.description: Date results were first posted on ClinicalTrials.gov. Null until the trial has posted results.

why_stopped.title: Why Stopped
why_stopped.description: Free-text reason the trial stopped early, as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov. Null for trials that did not stop early.

primary_outcomes.title: Primary Outcomes
primary_outcomes.description: The trial's primary outcome measures (primary endpoints) as reported by ClinicalTrials.gov. The endpoints a prediction market settles on.

program_id.title: Program Id
program_id.description: Durable Pav program identifier linked to this trial.

short_name.title: Short Name
short_name.description: Internal company slug that owns the linked program.

company_id.title: Company Id
company_id.description: Pav company identifier that owns the linked program.

drug.title: Drug
drug.description: Drug/asset name of the linked program.

EnterpriseApiKey.description: Use a user or organization Clerk API key from Pav developer settings. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.

tags.name: programs
tags.description: Search and filter drug pipeline assets by company, indication, target, modality, phase, or free text. Includes get-by-id, similar-programs, and facet autocomplete.

tags.name: companies
tags.description: Tracked biopharma companies and their pipeline ownership. List a company's programs and change history.

tags.name: trials
tags.description: Search Pav's product clinical-trial index — ClinicalTrials.gov records plus Pav program/company links. Hybrid search when `q=` is set; filtered browse otherwise.

tags.name: deals
tags.description: Biopharma deals (M&A, licensing, collaborations, options, joint ventures) from SEC filings and press releases, with lifecycle state, headline economics, and source documents.

tags.name: patents
tags.description: US patent families from USPTO with owners resolved to Pav companies, member applications, ownership history, and statutory term.

tags.name: changes
tags.description: Detected pipeline movement events per company — added and removed assets and phase changes — with before/after phase and detection time.

tags.name: stats
tags.description: High-level dataset counts and facet coverage for the current snapshot.
